setup_data.title: Keep the complete permitted player
setup_data.instruction: On Windows, select BanjoTooieRecompiled.exe in your existing permitted copy and keep assets plus the supplied SDL2/DXC libraries together in its working folder. On Linux, retain run.sh for upstream launch, or select the native BanjoTooieRecompiled with that extracted folder as its working directory. The wrapper supplies that folder; the native build still needs its documented Vulkan, shared-library and file-dialog portal prerequisites.

setup_data.title: Choose your original cartridge dump on first Play
setup_data.instruction: Choose Play explicitly, then Select ROM and supply your own supported Banjo-Tooie USA .z64 in big-endian byte order. The documented input is a 32 MiB original cartridge dump; another region, byte order or modified image is not equivalent. The released player reads it directly, without a separate extraction or compiler step.

setup_data.title: Keep your actual profile when updating
setup_data.instruction: You or upstream own runtime updates. Preserve the complete player folder, original game and actual profile: normally %LOCALAPPDATA%\BanjoTooieRecompiled on Windows or ~/.config/BanjoTooieRecompiled on Linux. Flatpak instead uses ~/.var/app/io.github.Vidanox.BanjoTooieRecompiled/config/BanjoTooieRecompiled. Keep settings and saves together and retain a working copy before replacing it. Portcove does not adopt or back up these external files, rewind saves or guarantee older-runtime readability.
